x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
from math import gcd, floor, ceil

if n >= y:
    g = gcd(x, y)
    num = x // g
    den = y // g
else:
    min_diff = 1e15
    num = 0
    den = 1
    ratio = x / y
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        candidate_floor = floor((x * i) / y)
        if abs(candidate_floor / i - ratio) < min_diff:
            num = candidate_floor
            den = i
            min_diff = abs(candidate_floor / i - ratio)
        candidate_ceil = ceil((x * i) / y)
        if abs(candidate_ceil / i - ratio) < min_diff:
            num = candidate_ceil
            den = i
            min_diff = abs(candidate_ceil / i - ratio)

print(f"{num}/{den}")
